Jess (Sales): Hey team - Evora wants to run an integration POC next Tue for their recommendation engine. They expect a short warmup then a spike during demo. Can we provision a temporary hosted key + a rate bump?
Matt (Infra): What numbers are they asking for?
Jess (Sales): Asking for ~500 rps for a 20-min demo window and ~80 rps sustained for 2 hours. Total tokens low, it's latency-driven.
Sam (Platform): 500 rps sustained for 20m is sizable on hosted. We can do a scoped ephemeral key + quota override if Security OKs IP restrictions.
Nora (Security): Need clarification: will requests come from a static IP range or from users' browsers? IP allowlist only works if requests come from Evora's server side.
Jess (Sales): It'll be server-to-server from their staging cluster, static egress IPs available. They can provide the /24 ranges.
Nora (Security): OK. We'll require: scoped key (no write to logs), 48h TTL, IP allowlist, and request signing disabled for the demo. Also need their SOC contact.
Kai (SRE): Guardrails: we can create a temporary policy: 20-min high-burst window at 500 rps, then fallback to 80 rps. We'll keep metrics and alerting. Any cost approvals needed?
Sam (Platform): Sales: this is a supported POC so we can absorb small overage. If they actually sustain long-term, we move to Dedicated.
Jess (Sales): Noted. Evora accepts transient cost risk for demo. They signed the POC addendum.
Matt (Infra): I'll prepare the scoped key + quota override. Need a ticket with exact IPs + start/end UTC times. Also add a note if they want streaming responses (changes connection concurrency).
Jess (Sales): Start: 2028-04-10T18:30:00Z end: 2028-04-10T21:00:00Z. IPs: 35.198.12.0/24, 35.198.13.0/24. Streaming yes (server-side SSE).
Matt (Infra): Got it. Will set: high_burst_rate=500 rps window=20m, sustained_rate=80 rps, key_ttl=48h, ip_allowlist as provided.
Nora (Security): I'll review the ticket. Also confirm that the key scope is limited to `generation:read` and disabled for embeddings/rerank.
Sam (Platform): Confirmed. Keep logs redaction on, token-level tracing off.
Jess (Sales): ETA on key + details so I can share with the customer?
Matt (Infra): Give me ~25 minutes after ticket created. I'll post the ephemeral key and curl sample here.
Kai (SRE): I'll attach an ad-hoc dashboard for Evora and set an alert to slack #eng-oncall if error rate > 2% or latency > 1.5s p95 during the window.
(25 minutes later)
deploy-bot: Ephemeral key created: scoped to generation:read, expires in 48h, IP allowlist applied. Key ID: ephem_8a9f3b. Details in ticket REDWOOD-POC-411.
Matt (Infra): Here's the sample curl for Evora to test (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \ 
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
 -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","inputs":"summarize: ...","stream":true}'
```
Matt (Infra): Note: for streaming use long-lived connections; we bumped concurrent connection limit for this key to 150.
Jess (Sales): I'll send this to Evora and confirm they can do the IP egress. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Nora (Security): Dropping one more note: access logs will be retained for 7 days for the POC only. No full audit export.
Kai (SRE): All monitoring configured. I'll be watching the channel during the demo window.
Evora (customer via email): Received key and test ok, seeing ~450 rps in pre-demo load test, no errors.
Jess (Sales): Sweet. Flag me if anything degrades.
Matt (Infra): If we see sustained >80 rps after the window, automatic fallback to model-q4-small will trigger (cheaper, lower latency).
Jess (Sales): Understood. Follow-up: can we get a rough estimate of incremental cost if they sustain 80 rps for a month?
Sam (Platform): Quick ballpark: ~ $2.1k/mo for 80 rps steady gen on rw-gpt-7b (token assumptions). I'll open a pricing note for Sales to formalize.
Jess (Sales): Perfect — I'll keep that separate. Thanks everyone!
Kai (SRE): :eyes:
